parameters.text:
=Parse this Turkish tech news article.

ARTICLE MARKDOWN:
{{ $json.markdown }}

PRE-EXTRACTED EMBED IDs:
Twitter IDs: {{ JSON.stringify($json.extractedTweetIds || []) }}
YouTube IDs: {{ JSON.stringify($json.extractedYoutubeIds || []) }}

---
TASKS:
1. Clean markdown (remove nav, footer, social buttons)
2. INSERT embed tokens using provided IDs:
   - Twitter: [[EMBED:TWEET:id]]
   - YouTube: [[EMBED:YOUTUBE:id]]
3. Find featured image URL
4. Find original source (after 'Kaynak:')
5. Write brief Turkish summary

RETURN ONLY valid JSON:
{"cleanContent": "...", "youtubeIds": [], "tweetIds": [], "featuredImage": "", "originalSource": "", "summary": ""}

=Translate this Turkish tech news article to English.

ORIGINAL TITLE: {{ $('Extract Date & Metadata').item.json.originalTitle }}

TURKISH SUMMARY: {{ $json.output.summary }}

TURKISH CONTENT:
{{ $json.output.cleanContent }}

---
RULES:
1. Translate to clear, professional English
2. PRESERVE embed tokens exactly: [[EMBED:YOUTUBE:id]] [[EMBED:TWEET:id]]
3. Add TL;DR section at start:

## TL;DR
[1-2 sentence summary]

### Key Highlights
- Point 1
- Point 2
- Point 3

---
[Translated article]

4. NO nuvemmag.com URLs in output

RETURN ONLY valid JSON:
{"title": "English title", "description": "Meta description", "content": "Full translated content with TL;DR"}

=Analyze this category page markdown and extract all article entries.

MARKDOWN:
{{ $json.markdown }}

---
EXTRACT each article with:
- title: Article headline
- url: Full URL (https://nuvemmag.com/article-slug/)
- date: Publication date (relative like '3 gün önce' or absolute like '15 Aralık 2025')

URL FORMAT: Articles use https://nuvemmag.com/article-slug/ (NOT /post/)

RETURN ONLY valid JSON:
{"articles": [{"title": "...", "url": "https://nuvemmag.com/...", "date": "..."}]}

If no articles found, return: {"articles": []}
